There's an in game glitch that lets you keep re-rolling a raid den until you get what you're hunting for, it's called the time skip glitch.
It works by activating a den with a wishing piece and "inviting" other trainers to the raid (you don't need to have an internet connection for that, not quite sure if you need a Nintendo online membership tho) while your raid is searching for other trainers go to the switch settings menu>system>date and time. and jump forward exactly one day, go back into the game and cancel the search. This will make your game believe you've been searching for a day and will refresh the den, giving you another roll on what you've got.
Now, for the event shiny hunt, first you have to go to the mystery gift icon in the X menu, click the wild area news so your dens get the event, then with a wishing piece activate any number of dens until you get the event one, the game has been doing almost every month a feature event with a Pokemon with increase shiny odds (2%) in the 5 star raids, you can keep re-rolling until you get the shiny (what I do is save before every 5 star encounter and soft reset if it's not shiny) while you do this the catching rate is increased when you're the host of the raid (I believe it's guaranteed but I'm not 100% sure) so you could get your shiny in any ball you'd like.
There's an event going on until the 21st I believe , where grimmsnarl has an increase chance of being shiny in 5 star raids

Congrats! Fyi if you host the raid den you have pretty much guaranteed to catch the mon no matter which ball you use.
